audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 matches 53.86% over 5269 games: Viktor's range wins levels 1-2, her Q parity evens the middle, her 6 (point-blank guaranteed Frozen Tomb on a dashless mage) is her window, and two-item Viktor out-DPSes her utility kit.
